_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.no_cards: Kāore he kāri i te wā nei.
player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Kaiwhakatūpato Tahi ki te Kaitākaro

📖 Tirohanga Whānui o te Kēmu:
• Ka tīmata koe ki te {start_chips} karaihe
• Wharau kotahi o 52 kāri (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Ka tākaro koe ki te kaitākaro (whare)
• Ka whai te rārangi o te Ultimate Texas Hold'em: ka whakapau koe ki te ANTE me te BLIND, ka whiwhi koe ki te 2 kāri hōro, ka whakatau koe ki te PLAY bets, ka whakaatu koe ki te kāri hapori, ka whakaritea koe ki te ringa pai o te kaitākaro. Ko tōu whāinga ko te whakanui i ōu utu (ka pai ake tōu ringa), me te whakaiti i ōu ngaromanga (ka pai ake te ringa o te kaitākaro).
• Ka mutu te kēmu ka tae koe ki te 0 karaihe, ka tīmata rānei koe ki te 1000 rārangi me te karaihe (WIN)

💰 Te Rārangi o te Whakapau:
• ANTE: Whakapau wāhi ${ante} i ia rārangi
• BLIND: Whakapau wāhi ${ante} i ia rārangi
• PLAY: Whakapau kōwhiringa i te wā o te kēmu. Ka taea e koe te kōwhiri KO TE TĀNAHI: (${ante4} ki te mahia i te PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} ki te mahia i te FLOP, ${ante} rānei ki te mahia i te RIVER. Ka taea hoki e koe te koropiko i te awa, ka tuku i te ringa, ka kore e whakapau.)

🎴 Te Tuku Kāri:
• Ka whiwhi koe ki te 2 kāri kanohi-mai (ōu kāri hōro)
• Ka whiwhi te kaitākaro ki te 2 kāri kanohi-whakaaro (huna i a koe)
• Ka tuku te 5 kāri hapori kanohi-whakaaro i te tīmatanga
• Ka whakaatuhia te kāri hapori i te wā o te kēmu

🏆 Te Whakarite o te Kaitākaro:
• Ka whai te kaitākaro ki te iti rawa o te PAIR (2 kāri o te rite tonu) ki te whakarite, ki te whakamahi i te 2 kāri i tōna ringa me te 5 kāri hapori.
• Ka pā te whakarite o te kaitākaro ki te whakapau, ka whakamāramatia ki muri.

🎮 Ngā Wāhanga o te Kēmu me ngā Mahi:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Mahi: [4x] (${ante4}) ki te [check]
  • [4x]: Whakapau ${ante4} PLAY, whakaatu te 3 kāri hapori tuatahi
  • [check]: Kore e whakapau, whakaatu te 3 kāri hapori tuatahi

📋 FLOP:
  • Ki te whakapau 4x: Ko te [skip] anake e wātea ana (auto-whakaatu te 2 kāri hapori whakamutunga)
  • Ki te kore e whakapau 4x: [2x] (${ante2}) ki te [check]
  • [2x]: Whakapau ${ante2} PLAY, whakaatu te 2 kāri hapori whakamutunga
  • [check]: Kore e whakapau, whakaatu te 2 kāri hapori whakamutunga

📋 RIVER:
  • Ki te whakapau 4x ki te 2x: Ko te [skip] anake e wātea ana (auto-whakahaere ki te showdown)
  • Ki te kore e whakapau PLAY: [1x] (${ante}) ki te [fold]
  • [1x]: Whakapau ${ante} PLAY, whakahaere ki te showdown
  • [fold]: Tuku te ringa, ngaro te ANTE me te BLIND

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Whakaatuhia ngā kāri katoa, whakaritea
  • Ko te ringa pai rawa o te 7 kāri (2 hōro + 5 hapori)
  • Whakaritea ngā whakapau ki te ture whakapau

💎 Ngā Utu o te Whakapau:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Ka kore te kaitākaro e whakarite: PUSH (whakapau whakahoki)
  • Ka whakarite te kaitākaro, ka wini koe: 1:1 utu (whakapau + utu)
  • Ka whakarite te kaitākaro, ka hinga koe: Whakapau ngaro
  • Tie: PUSH (whakapau whakahoki)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Ka kore e pā te whakarite o te kaitākaro
  • Ka wini koe: Whakapau whakahoki, utu tāpiri ki te kaha o tōu ringa
  • Ka hinga koe: Whakapau ngaro
  • Tie: PUSH (whakapau whakahoki)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Kore e utu tāpiri

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Ka kore e pā te whakarite o te kaitākaro
  • Whakarite tōtika: Tōu ringa pai ki te ringa pai o te kaitākaro
  • Ka wini koe: 1:1 utu (whakapau + utu)
  • Ka hinga koe: Whakapau ngaro
  • Tie: PUSH (whakapau whakahoki)

🎯 Ngā Rārangi o ngā Ringa Poka (Pai ki te Kōaro):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 o te rite tonu
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kāri tata o te rite tonu
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kāri o te rite tonu
  4. Full House: 3 o te rite tonu + 2 o te rite tonu
  5. Flush: 5 kāri o te rite tonu
  6. Straight: 5 kāri tata
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kāri o te rite tonu
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs o te rite rerekē
  9. One Pair: 2 kāri o te rite tonu
  10. High Card: Te kāri teitei rawa e wini ana

⌨️  Ngā Tohutohu Mahi:
• [4x] ki te [play bet 4x]: Whakapau ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY
• [2x] ki te [play bet 2x]: Whakapau ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY
• [1x] ki te [play bet 1x]: Whakapau ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY
• [check] ki te [c]: Check (kore e whakapau)
• [fold] ki te [f]: Fold (tuku te ringa)
• [skip] ki te [s]: Skip ki te wāhanga whakamutunga (ka kore e mahi)

💡 Ngā Kupu Tohutohu:
• Ngā ringa tīmata kaha (pairs, kāri teitei) he pai ki te whakapau 4x
• Whakaarohia te whakarite o te kaitākaro - ngā ringa kōaro he pai ki te whakapau ki te kore e whakarite te kaitākaro
• Te whakapau BLIND he pai ki te whakapau ki te ringa kaha (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Tirohia tōu karaihe! Ki te tae ki te 0 ki te tīmatanga o te rārangi, ka hinga koe.

⚠️  Ngā Kupu Whakamārama:
• Ngā whakapau ANTE me te BLIND he wāhi wāhi i ia rārangi
• Ngā whakapau PLAY he kōwhiringa, he rautaki
• Whakapau koe ki te tohu tika, ki te tohu kotahi anake i te wā.
